decks.notes: This deck revolves around assembling a strong board presence quickly and overwhelming your opponent with efficient creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing a diverse mana base and the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring, you can consistently play your powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Nishoba Brawler alongside spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt. The Leyline enchantments provide additional support to protect your creatures and maximize their potential. Overall, this deck is focused on aggressive plays and applying pressure early on to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Amulet Titan combo by utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Urza's Saga to generate massive mana and tutor for key pieces such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By ramping up quickly and efficiently, the deck can overwhelm opponents with powerful land drops and explosive plays. The main goal is to chain together multiple land drops and abilities to put the opponent on the back foot and ensure victory through an overwhelming board state.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to gain a significant advantage over opponents. Faithful Mending and Tainted Indulgence help to dig for combo pieces while controlling the board with cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing the graveyard as a resource with Fallaji Archaeologist and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly assembling combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to pressure opponents while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. Molten Collapse provides additional burn damage, while cards like Angrath's Rampage and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offer versatile removal options. The deck can also utilize graveyard recursion with cards like Undying Evil and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, providing resilience and flexibility in dealing with threats. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, disruption, and aggression.

The core idea of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive gameplay style. The deck combines efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Tarmogoyf with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to apply pressure early on. Mishra's Bauble and Abundant Harvest help to maintain card advantage and consistency while cards like Soul-Scar Mage and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional support to the aggro strategy. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total and secure victory before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly putting Atraxa into play through a combination of instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude. The deck also utilizes cards like Faithful Mending and Polluted Delta to manipulate the graveyard and search for key combo pieces. Once Atraxa is on the battlefield, the deck can take advantage of her abilities to control the board and win the game with a strong board presence. The strategy revolves around efficiently reanimating powerful creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with targeted removal and disruption spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive and disruptive plays, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to apply pressure. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to deal with opposing threats, as well as utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Takenuma, Abandoned Mire to provide additional benefits.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays, overwhelming the opponent with early creature threats like Grief, Orcish Bowmasters, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. Dauthi Voidwalker disrupts the opponent's game plan while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Not Dead After All provide additional value. Thoughtseize and disruption spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push help control the board. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption and card advantage, making it a versatile and powerful aggro deck in Modern format.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to consistently cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six onto the battlefield. By combining a mix of ramp, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with unexpected threats while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. The strategy relies on creativity and flexibility to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through powerful combos and synergy.

This deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures to combo off and generate value. It utilizes cards such as Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures like Wall of Roots, Blood Artist, and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also includes versatile creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to help control the board and generate card advantage. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to assemble a synergistic combination of creatures that work together to generate value and achieve victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells for a quick victory. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls, Shardless Agent, and Ardent Plea, the deck aims to generate a constant stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to protect the board and ensure the cascade spells resolve successfully. The deck's strategy revolves around aggressive plays and leveraging the randomness of cascade to gain an advantage in the match.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Tower, Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for powerful late-game plays such as casting huge threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger or activating Ugin, the Spirit Dragon's devastating abilities. Karn, the Great Creator provides versatile options for dealing with various threats, while cards like Oblivion Stone and All Is Dust help control the board. The deck aims to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats and card advantage.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize, while also utilizing cards like Persist and Bitter Reunion to maintain card advantage. Wrenn and Six provides additional value while cards like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push help control the board. The mana base includes fetch lands to ensure consistency in casting spells, and Boseiju, Who Endures can help protect key combo pieces from counterspells. Overall, the deck focuses on creatively comboing out powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to assemble powerful board states and combo off for game-winning plays. By using cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value and sac outlets, the deck aims to control the board and create advantageous situations for itself. With cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor up key pieces as needed to create combos and overwhelm the opponent. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility and adaptability to various situations in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to combo off with Dwarven Mine tokens and Leyline Binding to bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide control and recursion, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Change the Equation offer unique win conditions. The deck also utilizes versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to control the board. Overall, the deck aims to unleash creative combos and strategies to overwhelm the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and play Primeval Titan as quickly as possible. This combo allows the player to search for specific lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, and Boros Garrison to secure the win. The deck also includes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Explore to ramp up quickly and ensure consistent land drops. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to assemble the necessary lands and combo pieces efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Titan plays.
